narrative_purpose: Kills the blue-skin-means-copper-blood misconception in one image: the colour lives in the outer skin layers, the oxygen chemistry underneath it is red and packed inside cells.
subject: A vertical two-band anatomical study. The upper band is a cross-section through blue-hued skin: an outer layer holding scattered dark pigment granules, and beneath it a band of fine regularly spaced translucent structural layers that scatter light to a cool blue. The lower band, separated by a thin sheet of pale connective tissue, is a cross-section of a deep blood vessel carrying many discrete rounded cells, each one filled with deep red pigment and each clearly bounded by its own membrane, with the fluid between them pale and clear.
scene: A dark naturalist specimen space, the two bands presented as one continuous tissue section pinned in glowing display, deep indigo beyond the edges.
camera: Flat-on cross-section view, both bands filling the frame, the dividing tissue sheet running horizontally across the middle.
light: Cool scattered blue light in the upper band appearing to come from the structural layers themselves; a deeper interior glow in the lower band picking out the red cell contents; dark at both outer edges.
palette: Cool cyan-blue scattering in the upper band, deep muted crimson confined strictly to the cell interiors below, pale neutral for the plasma, void-indigo surround.
style: Painterly naturalist anatomical plate, oil texture, observed specimen confidence.
detail_level: Crisp on the structural scattering layers and on the individual cell membranes; the connective sheet between them softer; frame edges dissolving into shadow.
composition: Two stacked horizontal bands of near-equal weight divided by a thin pale sheet, the strong colour contrast between them carrying the whole image, quiet dark margins left and right.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette. Critically, the blood must read as red and the redness must be confined inside discrete cells with clear plasma around them; the blue must live only in the skin layers above.
negative_prompt: no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no diagram lines, no blue blood, no flat vector art, no infographic styling, no UI, no watermarks, no 3D render
